scope: Launchpad opens a single floating search field above its seven-column grid with a global shortcut. The Dock opens the integrated search view.

checks.command: Install the combined launcher in a disposable KDE neon Wayland VM, activate the registered shortcut, type into the detached field, dismiss it, and open the normal launcher through Plasma. Verify the separate search capsule and the 1028 by 634 logical pixel Apps panel in both editions and appearances.

coverage_limits: Plasma 6.8.1 on KDE neon Wayland. KRunner occupied Alt+Space in both guests, so the interactive checks used Meta+Alt+Space.
